text_block_list.text:
I'm out walking with Мэйсё Дото, when
I hear a
whisper calling to me...

Excuse me! I know this is sudden, but do
you have a
moment?
text_block_list.name: Агнес Диджитал

text_block_list.text:
I believe this wallet belongs to Doto...
Here, please take
it, but don't say
anything!
text_block_list.name: Агнес Диджитал
choice_data_list: But she's right next to us.

text_block_list.text: Y-yes, hello. I'm right here...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text: Y-yes, I am very aware of that, but... Nghhh... I could never hand something directly to an Umamusume with these grubby otaku mitts.
text_block_list.name: Агнес Диджитал

text_block_list.text:
I mean, just breathing the same air is
doing an
absolute number on my pulse!
text_block_list.name: Агнес Диджитал

text_block_list.text:
I talk Агнес Диджитал down from her state
of
induced panic, successfully reuniting
the wallet
with its owner.

I'm so glad you made the effort to bring
it back
to me. Ohhh, thank you so much.
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Also... I would like to know if you want
anything
in return. I should... return the...
favor.
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Eep?! I, I can't accept anything! Your
words of
thanks are good enough, if not
too much!
text_block_list.name: Агнес Диджитал

text_block_list.text:
Th-th-th-that can't be enough! Surely,
there must
be... something I can do...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text: Asdfsdfg?!! Stop... you're too cute! I must enshrine that expression into my mind's shrine foreverrr!!1!1
text_block_list.name: Агнес Диджитал

text_block_list.text:
This conversation isn't going anywhere.
Maybe if I
offer something that Agnes
Digital would enjoy...
choice_data_list: How about I take a photo of the two of you?

text_block_list.text: What? That won't be infringing on any laws, will it?! Is this really, really, really really allowed?!
text_block_list.name: Агнес Диджитал

text_block_list.text: EЭпизод.. a photo! I'll... do my best!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
We change locations to get a good shot,
but
Мэйсё Дото is stiff as a rock.
Hwah... Uh... Uh... Uh!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Hnngh! She's so timid I could die—a
goddess lives
among us! Cuteness
radiates from her every pore!
text_block_list.name: Агнес Диджитал

text_block_list.text: H-huuuh?! C-cute?
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
OmiGOSH!!! Look at her blush! She can
barely
contain her excitement, and she
knows it!
text_block_list.name: Агнес Диджитал

text_block_list.text:
W-wait, I'm blushing?! This is so
embarrassing!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото
choice_data_list: All right, let's see if we can get a smile!

text_block_list.text: Uwahh! O-okay!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text: Uh... like this? Hm... hm?
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Aghskdlf! That desperate attempt at a
smile...
Doto, you're so so so cuuuuute!
text_block_list.name: Агнес Диджитал

text_block_list.text: Wh-wh-what? ...Wait, wh-what?!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
I c-can't smile?! Wh-what do I do
nooow?!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото
choice_data_list: Try to picture a smile in your head.
Why not go for a little run?

text_block_list.text: Oh... o... okay! Um... Here I go!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text: HAAAAH ha ha ha!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
WAIT! Is th-that, by chance, your
impression of
Opera O?!
text_block_list.name: Агнес Диджитал

text_block_list.text:
Th-that's right! Apologies for the
trouble, but her
smile and laugh was the
most memorable to me!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text: Haaah ha ha ha! HAAAH HA HA HA!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text: Well... a-am I smiling now?
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
So precious... I'd follow you forever...
N-not that I
wasn't already following
you!
text_block_list.name: Агнес Диджитал

text_block_list.text: HAAAH HA—Cough, sputter!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
O-okay! I'll clear my mind with some
running!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text: Kyaaaaghgh!
text_block_list.name: Агнес Диджитал

text_block_list.text: ...I th-think I went a little overboard. Huff... Puff... I'm at my limit.
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Whoa whoa! My legs got all tangled...
Oh no!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text: Hwaaugh!
text_block_list.name: Агнес Диджитал

text_block_list.text: Oh no, I'm s-so so sorry! I didn't mean to hug you... So, so sorry about this!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Ack, gugh, no! This is taboo! We've
crossed the
line that never should be
cr... cr... cr...
text_block_list.name: Агнес Диджитал

text_block_list.text:
Heh... hehe! No! This is wrong! So wrong!
But I
can't stop smiling! ♪
text_block_list.name: Агнес Диджитал

text_block_list.text:
What a heartwarming scene. I take a
picture of
the moment to give to them.

Too much laughing leaves Мэйсё Дото
in a
coughing fit, but she manages to get
through the
photo.
